members.name: Shaun Porwal
members.bio: Shaun builds **biomedical AI systems** across agentic workflows, survival modeling, and biology models. He recently worked as a **founding engineer at a biotech startup** and previously built clinical ML tools at **Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center**, where he created [dcurves](https://github.com/MSKCC-Epi-Bio/dcurves). He also has **hands-on chemistry experience** in labs and manufacturing across the U.S., Taiwan, and Japan, and holds degrees in biomedical engineering and biomedical data science.
